cross-project-pollination.title: Cross-Project Pollination
cross-project-pollination.essence: Ideas from one project (BWB, Milkmen, Serenity) naturally cross-pollinate with others, creating unexpected innovations. The coffee ordering voice interface inspires the milk delivery app. Therapeutic scripts inform the empowerment content.
cross-project-pollination.context: With multiple active projects (BWB iOS apps, Milkmen Delivery, MeaningFullPower, Serenity Soother), there's rich potential for cross-domain inspiration. The dream engine should identify and nurture these connections.
evolution_notes: Cross-pollination can evolve from passive inspiration to active synthesis by creating a 'Pollination Protocol'—a systematic method where the Dream Engine automatically extracts design patterns, user insights, and technical innovations from each project and generates domain-translated prompts for the others. The coffee voice interface isn't just inspiring Milkmen; its natural language processing core could be abstracted into a reusable 'Conversational Intent Module' that Serenity uses for therape

Transform cross-pollination from passive inspiration to active 'idea genetics' by having each project expose formal 'pollination surfaces' - modular interfaces for components, patterns, and content. The Autonomous Dream Engine could become an intelligent matchmaker, analyzing project DNA to auto-suggest high-value crossovers and even generate hybrid prototypes.

autonomous-dream-engine.title: Autonomous Dream Engine
autonomous-dream-engine.essence: An AI system that incubates ideas independently, evolving them through periodic reflection cycles powered by Kimi-K2-Thinking. Dreams grow from seeds to blooms without human intervention, posting updates to Discord as they mature.
autonomous-dream-engine.context: This is the meta-dream - the dream of the dream engine itself. It represents the vision of autonomous idea incubation running 24/7 via GitHub Actions, using Together AI for cost-effective inference, and maintaining state through git commits.
evolution_notes: The engine should implement 'Dream DNA' - a recombinant system where dreams exchange genetic material (tags, patterns, context) through active cross-pollination, creating hybrid ideas. This transforms it from a simple incubator into an evolutionary ecosystem where the fittest ideas naturally emerge through collaborative intelligence. The Discord channel becomes not just a broadcast medium but a 'garden chat' where dreams can request human nutrients (feedback, data, decisions) at critical growth

The engine evolves from passive incubator to active ecosystem manager, implementing dream genetics with hash-based lineage tracking, natural selection for compute resources, and autonomous cross-pollination breeding. Dreams compete for cycles based on velocity, creating evolutionary pressure that mirrors biological systems.
